title: Latin squares with non-partitioning disjoint subsquares
summary: A latin square of order $n$ with pairwise disjoint subsquares of orders $h_1,\dots,h_k$ such that $h_1+\dots+h_k = n$ is known as a realization. The existence of realizations is a partially solved problem with a few general results for an arbitrary number of subsquares, $k$. Requiring only that $h_1+\dots+h_k\leq n$ gives a variation of the problem that has few known results. In this paper we prove a general necessary condition for existence and completely determine existence when there are at most three subsquares or the subsquares are all of the same order.
